proof_summary: Writing \(U=1+x\), \(V=y+z\), and \(W=y-z\), binomial expansion and homogeneity isolate the \(x^ny^nz^n\)-coefficient as \(\binom{2n}{n}\) times a single sum of coefficients \([y^nz^n]V^{2n-2j}W^{2j}\).  The relation \(W^2=V^2-4yz\), together with induction and binomial recurrences, gives \(\binom{2n}{2j}[y^nz^n]V^{2n-2j}W^{2j}=(-1)^j\binom{2n}{n}\binom nj\); substituting makes the sum a multiple of \(\sum_j\binom nj^2=\binom{2n}{n}\), yielding the cube.
